svg.title: Ride-hailing platform — Trip DB primary goes down, then an etcd node too (3/5): To protect the replica, pricing and ETA predictions are switched to brownout.

g.data-title: Ride-hailing platform — Trip DB primary goes down, then an etcd node too (3/5): To protect the replica, pricing and ETA predictions are switched to brownout.

g.title: Trip DB (primary) unavailable, using Trip DB (replica)
Trip DB (primary) unavailable, using Trip DB (replica)

g.text: impaired — Serving, but with reduced redundancy or a nice-to-have missing.
brownout — Deliberately shedding load: surge pricing and ETA predictions switched off.
